intro: I'm JM Munna, a video editor and student who enjoys turning raw footage into stories worth watching.
biography:
Editing started as a curiosity — cutting clips together just to see how they'd feel — and it's grown into something I take seriously. Right now I split my time between schoolwork and editing, using every project as a chance to get sharper with pacing, sound, and color. I'm drawn to work that respects the viewer's attention: nothing overdone, nothing wasted.
